page.title: System Settings
page.description: Manage authentication, email, webhooks, and other platform configuration.

currency.title: Currencies
currency.description: The global currency list offered when entering amounts (procurement, HR). Built-in codes are always available; add your own below.
currency.hint: Use a 3-letter ISO code (e.g. AUD, CAD, KRW).

lode.title: Updates (lode)
lode.unavailable: Not running under the lode supervisor — updates and restart are managed externally.
lode.holdActive: Maintenance hold is active — lode will not (re)start the app.
lode.restartConfirmDescription: lode will stop the current version and relaunch it (re-reading lode.toml). The app will be briefly unavailable.
lode.updateConfirmDescription: lode will download and switch to "{{target}}", rolling back automatically if the new version fails to start.
lode.rollbackConfirmDescription: lode will switch back to {{target}}. The app will be briefly unavailable.
lode.restartRequested: Restart requested. The app will relaunch shortly.
lode.updateRequested: Update requested ({{target}}). lode will apply it shortly.
lode.rollbackRequested: Rollback requested. lode will switch back shortly.
lode.holdSet: Maintenance hold set. lode will not restart the app.
lode.configUnavailable: lode.toml is present but could not be read.

defaults.title: Project Defaults
defaults.description: Values applied to new projects when the creator does not set them explicitly.
defaults.coverHint: The cover image applied to new projects. Upload an image, or leave it unset for no default cover.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: The global tag vocabulary shared across all projects.
tags.dialogDescription: Tags are shared across all projects.

delete.title: Delete tag
delete.confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? It will be removed from {{count}} project(s).

categories.title: Global Procurement Categories
categories.description: The template category set copied into every new project on creation.
categories.dialogDescription: Global categories seed each new project's procurement categories.

delete.title: Delete category
delete.confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? New projects will no longer seed this category.

auth.sessionDescription: Configure session lifetime and default administrators.

smtp.title: Email (SMTP)
smtp.description: Configure SMTP server for sending notification emails.
smtp.secureHint: Off: STARTTLS is used when the server offers it (typically port 587).

webhook.title: Webhooks
webhook.description: Configure webhook endpoints to receive event notifications.
webhook.noWebhooks: No webhooks configured. Click "Add Webhook" to get started.
webhook.eventsHint: Comma-separated event types, or * for all events.

globalWorklists.title: Global Worklists
globalWorklists.description: The knowledge-base worklist templates that ships copy from.
globalWorklists.dialogDescription: Global worklists are reusable templates ships can copy into their own worklists.

delete.title: Delete worklist
delete.confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Ships that already copied it keep their copy.

globalEquipmentCategories.title: Equipment Category Template
globalEquipmentCategories.description: The global template each ship copies its equipment categories from on creation.

dialog.description: Template categories are the bilingual vocabulary each ship copies into its own category set on creation.

globalEquipmentManufacturers.title: Equipment Manufacturers
globalEquipmentManufacturers.description: The global brand vocabulary ship equipment references by manufacturer.

dialog.deleteConfirm: Delete the manufacturer "{{name}}"? Equipment that references it will lose the link.
dialog.description: Manufacturers are the global brand vocabulary that ship equipment references.

contactCategories.title: Contact Categories
contactCategories.description: The global category vocabulary used to classify contacts.
contactCategories.dialogDescription: Contact categories classify contacts across the workspace.

delete.title: Delete category
delete.confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Contacts will no longer use this category.

export.title: Export
export.description: Generate a downloadable .tar.gz backup archive on the server, then download it.
export.modulesHint: Selected modules are exported together with their dependencies.
export.jobGone: The export job is no longer available on the server — either every artifact was downloaded or the server restarted.
export.externalBlobsNote: Backups contain database data only. Uploaded file bytes live in the storage directory (or S3 bucket) — copy it alongside the archive; paths are content-addressed so they always match.

import.title: Import
import.description: Upload a backup archive (.tar.gz). The server validates it and reports the exact effect of an import before anything is written.
import.confirmDescription: The archive is merged into the live database: new rows are inserted, duplicates are skipped, and live data is never deleted — unless you wipe first.
import.wipeExisting: Wipe all existing data first (import cannot conflict)
import.wipeWarning: Wipe deletes every row in the live database before importing the archive. The archive must contain an active admin. This cannot be undone.
import.blobRestoreDescription: Upload a legacy blobs.tar.gz produced by an older separate-files export. Blobs import straight into file storage; no data import is required.
import.blobRescanDescription: After copying the storage directory (or bucket) onto this instance, rescan to reconnect file records whose data was missing.

report.noKeyAppend: No primary key or unique index — rows appended as-is; duplicates are possible.

config.title: Storage configuration
config.description: Created files (text, markdown, spreadsheets) are always stored in the database. Choose where uploaded files go.
config.secretConfigured: A secret is saved. Leave blank to keep it.
config.secretPlaceholder: Enter a new secret to change it
config.s3Required: S3 requires a bucket, access key ID, and secret.

files.title: Server files
files.description: Every stored file and where it lives.
